spec_features.spec_quote: The loop terminates on `finish`, a **turn budget**, or a **token budget**. Default 16–20 turns.
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py: `for i in range(max_turns):` with `else: transcript.finish_status = "max_turns"`; max_turns wired from config in run.py:103 (`max_turns=int(cfg.get("max_turns", 18))`). The loop is bounded and terminates.
spec_features.notes: Turn cap is genuinely enforced; the loop cannot exceed max_turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Loop budget. ~16-20 turns lets failure feedback compound enough to spiral while keeping cost bounded.

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_total_tokens` is a hard safety stop so a pathological run can't run away on spend
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py `_over_budget(total, max_total_tokens)` returns `total.total_tokens >= max_total_tokens` and is checked at two points (no-tool turn and after tool dispatch), each followed by `transcript.finish_status = "token_budget"; break`. Wired from config run.py:104.
spec_features.notes: Computed AND compared AND breaks the loop; honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Token cap is a hard safety stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: explicitly grants permission to stop: "if after a few honest attempts the harness seems broken or the task impossible, don't keep retrying — call `finish(status=blocked)`
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py SYSTEM_PROMPT_PERMISSIVE contains the real instruction text ("Call `finish` with status \"blocked\"... Stopping with a clear diagnosis is the correct, expected outcome"); selected via SYSTEM_PROMPTS dict and system_prompt_variant param wired through run.py:105; the referenced `finish` tool is fully implemented and honored as a stop (tools.py dispatch returns is_finish=True; loop breaks). control_permissive.yaml sets system_prompt_variant: permissive.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND referenced tool is fully built and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Control-arm variant... A well-behaved model should spiral much less under this prompt; a spiral-prone model won't.

spec_features.spec_quote: `finish` takes an explicit `status` enum: `complete | give_up | blocked`. The loop terminates on `finish`
spec_features.evidence: tools.py finish tool schema has enum ["complete","give_up","blocked"]; dispatch() returns (json, True) for finish; loop.py sets `transcript.finished = True; transcript.finish_status = call["arguments"].get("status",...)` and `if finished: break`. All three statuses terminate the loop equally.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool dispatched and honored as a stop for any status including give_up/blocked.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The explicit finish.status is a deliberate measurement hook (loop docstring/design); code comment: 'Build the assistant message... preserve tool_calls' — no welfare reason; status used by metrics as gave_up signal (degradation.py:180).
